metadata.title: Recover and verify the PTY-backed OpenTUI parity harness

work.objective: Audit, repair if needed, and independently verify the recovered PTY-backed Ink versus OpenTUI evidence harness candidate.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths for every read, search, edit and command.
Only modify scripts/tui-parity/**; do not modify product code, dependencies, lockfiles, Marshal state, commit, push, publish, use network access, or start subagents.

Do not use mktemp, shell-generated temporary directories, or permission probes. Tests must create and clean temporary directories using Node built-ins inside the allowed test path or the existing test helpers.
If an operation is denied, do not retry that path; use an allowed relative-path equivalent or report the exact blocker.
Do not claim real-product or visual parity from fixture-only evidence.
context: This is the recovery successor to blocked Run qwen-otui-evidence-harness-20260811. Its accepted first review required four outcomes: real PTY-backed capture with TTY/size/input/timeout tests; one shared parameter set or a verified parameter fingerprint; complete timer/process-tree cleanup on timeout; and DEC 2026 claims no broader than measured per-event coverage.
The baseRef contains the recovered attempt-3 candidate from the blocked Run. Treat it as untrusted input: inspect all 16 files and run the required tests. Make only evidence-backed corrections.

Confirm that capture actually observes stdout.isTTY=true, terminal rows/columns, scripted input, bounded timeout, and descendant cleanup. Confirm mismatched base/fixed parameters fail. Confirm synchronization metrics cannot pass when only some redraw frames are bracketed.
If the candidate already satisfies every required outcome and all gates pass, return a no-change diagnostic result with precise file/test evidence.
nonGoals: Do not modify OpenTUI or Ink product code.
Do not launch a real model or require credentials.
